indicator_name: NBK household inflation expectations survey: every question (answer shares) and median estimates
description: Опрос населения по инфляционным ожиданиям НБК: все вопросы (доли ответов) и медианные оценки
methodology: Monthly from 2016-01 (FusionLab, ~1 500 adults). Item Q<N>.<answer> = share of respondents giving that answer (base in item_name); MEDIAN.PERCEIVED_12M / EXPECTED_12M / EXPECTED_5Y = the NBK's interval medians (EXPECTED_12M is the scalar INFLATION_EXPECTATIONS). Breaks: wording of Q1-Q6 changed 2020-01; 2022-01 not surveyed; Q6 answer buckets changed 2025-01 (second block = Q6.v2.*); from 2026-01 several questions quarterly or dropped. 2022-02: the printed Q6 shares are a copy of Q5's (source_issues inflation_expectations_2022_02).
